description: This file defines the `PolicyTreeNode` interface, which specifies the structure and behavior of nodes within a policy tree in the `org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers.tree` package. It includes methods for retrieving the node's name and type, managing child nodes, and accepting visitors for evaluation purposes.

classes.name: PolicyTreeNode
classes.description: Interface for all nodes in a policy tree, providing methods for node identification, hierarchy management, and visitor pattern implementation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this policy tree node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type (`RESOURCE` or `SUBJECT`) of this node.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves an optional child node corresponding to the specified resource name.

methods.name: computeIfAbsent
methods.description: Returns the existing child node for the given resource name or computes and adds a new one using the provided mapping function if absent.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns a map of all child nodes.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for evaluating or processing this node, following the visitor pattern.
